title: The RTL8922 Spectrum Spectacular
browser_recording_note: Optional passive UI footage, no new RF stimulus; no counters removed. Offline render uses still fallback.
audio: Original procedural music and effects; local eSpeak NG en-us+m3 synthetic announcer.

timeline.title: STOP THE SCROLL.
timeline.narration: Folks! Has your Wi-Fi card been wasting its life, doing Wi-Fi? Then step right up!
timeline.qualification: Actual RTL8922AE receive experiments. Dealership enthusiasm sold separately.

timeline.narration: Introducing the R T L eighty nine twenty two! One hundred and sixty million complex samples, every second! That's a lot of radio!
timeline.qualification: Experimental PAXI RX. 80 / 160 MS/s passed bounded 60-second application trials.

timeline.title: LOOK AT THAT WATERFALL.
timeline.narration: Real I Q! Real spectrum! Two hundred and forty F F Ts a second! Look at that waterfall!
timeline.qualification: 240 FFT/s target; screen refresh limits redraws. Recorded passive RX; Pluto TX off.

timeline.title: ONE BURST. ALL 160 MHz.
timeline.narration: And this beauty? One, one hundred and sixty megahertz Wi-Fi six burst! Eight slices! Eight valid header checksums!
timeline.qualification: Same HE-SU PHY header in eight 20 MHz sections. Two-stream payload not decoded.

timeline.title: THE CHECKSUMS CHECK OUT.
timeline.narration: Want receipts? We decoded a four hundred and forty one byte beacon, all the way to a matching frame checksum!
timeline.qualification: Legacy 20 MHz OFDM extracted from 160 MS/s I/Q. Independent FCS: a232c556.

timeline.title: BUT WAIT! THERE'S MORE!
timeline.narration: But wait! There's more! Two point four! Five! Six gigahertz! A stitched tour of the neighborhood!
timeline.qualification: Sequentially stitched survey, not simultaneous full-band RX. Above 6 GHz RF unqualified.

timeline.title: OVERFLOW? GET BACK UP.
timeline.narration: Tune while streaming! And if the receiver overflows? It marks the gap, reloads, and gets back in the game!
timeline.qualification: Retunes mark brief gaps without reload. Fault recovery reloads the isolated driver.

timeline.title: RTL8922 SDR
timeline.narration: R T L eighty nine twenty two S D R! Open source! Unreasonably entertaining! Experimental! Some assembly, and quite a lot of debugging, required!
timeline.qualification: One receive path. Firmware held. Indefinite continuity, full-band EVM / sensitivity unqualified.
